title: PublicKey
description: A public key in JWK form (RFC 7517). Used wherever the canonical model has to name a key rather than hold one: the agent key an open mandate is bound to, and the keys an agent publishes to a registry. Private key material never appears in the canonical model — keys sit behind the Signer port.

kty.description: Key type (RFC 7517 §4.1). 'EC' for the ECDSA keys AP2 requires on the Checkout JWT, 'OKP' for the Ed25519 keys TAP uses.

kid.description: Key identifier, used to select this key from a set (RFC 7517 §4.5).

alg.description: Algorithm this key is intended for, e.g. 'ES256' or 'EdDSA' (RFC 7517 §4.4).

crv.description: Curve, for 'EC' and 'OKP' keys, e.g. 'P-256' or 'Ed25519'.

x.description: base64url X coordinate ('EC') or public key ('OKP').
